description: This file defines the NestedSetInterface, an interface specifying methods for handling nested set tree structures in an ORM context. It declares methods for managing 'left' and 'right' values, 'level', and associated node objects.

classes.name: NestedSetInterface
classes.description: An interface declaring methods for accessing and modifying properties related to nested set trees, such as left, right, level, and node references.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Returns the 'left' value of the node, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the 'left' value for the node.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Returns the 'right' value of the node, or null if not set.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the 'right' value for the node.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level (depth) of the node in the tree, or null if not set.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level (depth) for the node.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Associates a NodeInterface object with this entity, or null.
